topic: June 2026 double deadline — KBLI 2025 (Jun 18) + annual RUPS report (Jun 30)

slides.headline: Two deadlines. One month.
slides.body: June 18: the KBLI 2025 transition closes. June 30: your annual report is due — and for the first time it must be filed with the government.

slides.headline: KBLI 2025: mostly automatic
slides.body: OSS and AHU convert your business codes automatically. Your NIB stays valid. Your licenses stay valid. No new akta for a pure renumber. But 'automatic' is not 'correct' — open OSS and check what you got.

slides.headline: When KBLI needs YOU
slides.body: 1. Your old code was SPLIT into several new ones — someone must choose. 2. A new code falls outside your deed's purpose clause — akta amendment. 3. PT PMA with multiple codes — each 5-digit code carries the >IDR 10B logic. Prune what you don't use.

slides.headline: Your annual report went public
slides.body: Shareholders must approve the 2025 annual report by June 30 (UU 40/2007). NEW this year: the approval must be a notarial deed, filed into SABH within 30 days (Permenkum 49/2025). The internal-formality era is over. Dormant PTs included.

slides.headline: Skip it and your PT freezes
slides.body: Written warning, then SABH access BLOCKED: no director changes, no share transfers, no deed amendments — and the freeze ripples into KITAS renewals and OSS updates. You discover it mid-transaction, at the worst moment.

slides.headline: Book the notary before everyone else does
slides.statement: Every PT in Indonesia needs one this month. KBLI check + RUPS + notarized SABH filing — handled end to end.
